title: Verb 'to be' (am/is/are) / Wani aiki ne 'yake' (na/ce/ne)
bridge: A Hausa muna da wata kalma kawai 'ne' da 'ke' wanda ke nufin 'to be' a Turanci. A Turanci ba a sake cire wani abu ba kamar yadda ake cire 'ne' ko 'ke' a Hausa. Saboda haka, a Turanci ba a iya cire wani abu ba, saboda za a iya cire 'I am', 'you are', 'he is' da sauransu.
rule: Wannan aiki 'to be' a yanzu yana da uku kalmomi: 'am' (da 'I'), 'is' (da 'he, she, it') da 'are' (da 'you, we, they'). Don harshen tambaya, an sauya daidaituwa: 'Are you...?', 'Is he...?'. Don harshen 'ba', an koyi 'not': 'I am not', 'he is not' (ko 'he isn't'), 'they are not' (ko 'they aren't').

common_error.explanation: A Hausa muna cewa 'Ina jin yunwa' ba tare da wani aiki ba, amma a Turanci, wannan aiki 'to be' ya kamata a yi. Kad'a da ake cire 'am/is/are' ba.

examples.note: Muna da amfani da 'am' kawai da 'I'.
Muna da amfani da 'is' da yake da 'third person singular'.
Wannan 'aren't' da ke da alama mai yawa a cikin magana.
Muna sauya daidaituwa da aiki don samar da tambaya.

title: Pronombres Masu Fage (Ina, Kai, Shi, Ita, Muna, Ku, Su)
bridge: A cikin Hausa, masu fage masu yawa suna da wata iri da wata. Watace farin ciki ce, a cikin Hausa ba muka yarda da cewa za a yi amfani da masu fage ko da yake a cikin turanci, saboda a turanci muka yi amfani da masu fage ko da yake a cikin turanci. Saboda haka, 'Ina da yunwa' (ba 'da yunwa' kawai ba). Da fatan za a tsammanin 'shi' da 'ita' — a turanci suna nufin jinsi na mutum, ba jinsin gramatik na kalma kamar yadda a cikin Hausa.
rule: Masu fage a turanci sune: Ina (ina), Kai (kai/ke/ku), Shi (shi), Ita (ita), Wannan (wannan), Muna (muna), Su (su). 'Wannan' ya dace da kayan aiki, manyan, ko ma'ana. 'Kai' ya dace da wata ko da yawa. Ba a yarda da cewa za a yi amfani da masu fage ko da yake a cikin turanci.

concept_examples.translation: Wannan wani littafi ne (wannan wani littafi ne).

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: A cikin Hausa muka yi 'Ya ke dalibi' ba tare da masu fage ba, amma a turanci masu fage ya zama mai muhimmanci. Da fatan za a yi 'Shi ya ke...' ko 'Ita ta ke...'.

levels.label: Third person singular
levels.translation: Masu fage na uku na farko

examples.note: Daga watace na mutane da yaro.
Daga watace na mutane ko kayan aiki.
'Wannan' ya dace da kayan aiki, manyan, ko ma'ana.

title: Articles (a/an, the) / Farko (a/an, da/the)
bridge: A cikin Hausa muna da wasu wasu wasu kalmomi masu nufin 'farko': 'wata/wani' (ba daidai ba) da 'da/da' (daidai). Daya daga cikin farillacewa shine cewa a cikin turanci ba mu yi amfani da 'the' don ma'ana masu nufin 'girmamawa' ba (muna cewa 'Life is beautiful', ba 'The life is beautiful'). Da fatan za a koma cewa da kwararrun fasaha muna yin amfani da 'a' ko 'an' a turanci: 'I am a teacher' (a cikin Hausa muna cewa 'Ina mahaifi' ba tare da farko ba).
rule: Muna yin amfani da 'a' kafin kalmomin da suka fara da sauti na 'tsaki' (a book, a car). Muna yin amfani da 'an' kafin kalmomin da suka fara da sauti na 'murya' (an apple, an hour — 'h' ba ta sauta). Muna yin amfani da 'the' don nufin wani abu mai alaka ko wanda ya gabata. Ba mu yi amfani da 'the' don ma'ana masu nufin 'girmamawa' ba (Love is important, ba 'The love').

common_error.explanation: A cikin Hausa muna cewa 'Ina mahaifi' ba tare da farko ba. A turanci, da kwararrun fasaha, muna yin amfani da 'a' ko 'an' ko 'da'.

examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'a' kafin kalmomin da suka fara da sauti na 'tsaki'.
Muna yin amfani da 'an' kafin kalmomin da suka fara da sauti na 'murya'.
'The' yana da amfani da wani abu mai alaka ko wanda ya gabata.

levels.label: No article (general concepts)
levels.translation: Ba tare da farko ba (ma'ana masu girmamawa)

examples.note: Don ma'ana masu girmamawa, ba mu yi amfani da 'the' ba.
